name: devsweep-inspect
upstream_inspiration: avdlee/xcode-disk-cleanup-agent-skill; orzcls/win-disk-cleaner; az9713/claude-skill-disk-cleanup; heyzgj/storage-cleanup-skill; thearmagan/skills@dry-run-first; affaan-m/ECC@config-gc; vinta/awesome-python@preview-verdicts

intent.job_to_be_done: Inspect this machine with the globally installed DevSweep CLI, recommend cleanup, and execute a confirmed Cleanup Plan without using this repository as the cleaner.
target_users: coding agents working in the DevSweep repository
developers who ask an agent to inspect disk space or clean developer caches
inputs: natural-language inspect, advice, or cleanup request
optional scan roots, scope, and risk filter
explicit confirmation of a displayed Cleanup Target list
outputs: selectable cleanup list that waits for confirmation
optional new observation, plan, preview, or execution JSON
exclusions: same-turn clean execute before a displayed list is confirmed
cargo run of this repository as the cleaner
